shortDescription: Information module for Application Visibility Network Devices

options.name: appTelemetryDeploymentStatus
options.description: AppTelemetryDeploymentStatus query parameter. Status of the application telemetry deployment on the network device. Available values SCHEDULED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, FAILED, NOT_DEPLOYED.

options.name: appTelemetryReadinessStatus
options.description: AppTelemetryReadinessStatus query parameter. Indicates whether the network device is ready for application telemetry enablement or not. Available values ENABLED, READY, NOT_READY, NOT_SUPPORTED.

options.name: applicationRegistrySyncStatus
options.description: ApplicationRegistrySyncStatus query parameter. Indicates whether the latest definitions from application registry have been synchronized with the network device or not. Available values SYNCING, IN_SYNC, OUT_OF_SYNC, NOT_APPLICABLE.

options.name: cbarDeploymentStatus
options.description: CbarDeploymentStatus query parameter. Status of the CBAR deployment on the network device. Available values SCHEDULED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, FAILED, NOT_DEPLOYED.

options.name: cbarReadinessStatus
options.description: CbarReadinessStatus query parameter. Indicates whether the network device is ready for CBAR enablement or not. Available values ENABLED, READY, NOT_READY, NOT_SUPPORTED.

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_host
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center hostname.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_port
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center port.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: headers
options.description: Additional headers.

options.name: hostname
options.description: Hostname query parameter. The host name of the network device. Partial search is supported. For example, searching for `switch` will include `edge-switch1.domain.com`, `switch25`, etc.

options.name: ids
options.description: Ids query parameter. List of network devices ids. If this parameter is not provided, all network devices will be included in the response. Multiple network device IDs can be provided.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. The number of records to show for this page. Minimum value is 1, Maximum value is 500.

options.name: managementAddress
options.description: ManagementAddress query parameter. The management address for the network device. This is normally IP address of the device. But it could be hostname in some cases like Meraki devices. Partial search is supported. For example, searching for `25.` would include `10.25.1.1`, `25.5.10.1`, `225.225.1.0`, `10.10.10.125`, etc.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. The first record to show for this page; the first record is numbered 1. Default value is 1.

options.name: order
options.description: Order query parameter. Whether ascending or descending order should be used to sort the response. Available values are asc, desc. Default value is asc.

options.name: protocolPackStatus
options.description: ProtocolPackStatus query parameter. Indicates whether the NBAR protocol pack is up-to-date or not on the network device. Available values LATEST, OUTDATED, UNKNOWN.

options.name: protocolPackUpdateStatus
options.description: ProtocolPackUpdateStatus query parameter. Status of the NBAR protocol pack update on the network device. Available values SCHEDULED, IN_PROGRESS, SUCCESS, FAILED, NONE.

options.name: siteId
options.description: SiteId query parameter. The site ID where the network device is assigned.

options.name: sortBy
options.description: SortBy query parameter. A property within the response to sort by.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
